notes: Basic mode: a finish-line display – SET, GO, FINISH and the finish order, no names, no times, nothing to set up
Basic: lanes whose laps don't match show Checking with DNF / DQ / OK; Previous race button
Basic: TVs and phones show the same finish order read-only, with the previous race underneath
A new kit, or one after a hire-out reset, asks Basic or Full first; change it any time in System › Setup
Races run in Basic are saved quietly and stay off the LiveHeats to-do list in Full
